cache_rule: For each cold-labelled call set cache_prompt=false, and for each warm-labelled call true. All input messages/tools, seed, sampling and output cap remain identical. Verify cache_n and prompt_n; no erase endpoint or server restart.
stop_rule: No retries. Stop on unknown usage, changed server identity, non-idle slot, cache-state mismatch, budget, or stop file. Preserve every attempted call and cleanup status.
scope: One known development input, capped generation only. Never execute generated tool calls, invoke AppWorld or a final evaluator. Not a task-effectiveness study, sample independence claim, or new research method.
source_version: v01 stopped before generation because slot actions require --slot-save-path, which the active server does not enable.
